title: Clans in Lanao del Sur rido to face frustrated murder raps

blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY – Authorities will file criminal charges against two warring families that clashed on Saturday in Picong, Lanao del Sur, which stranded hundreds of motorists for several hours along the national highway connecting the cities of Pagadian and Cotabato. Col. Caezar Cabuhat, Lanao del Sur Provincial Police Office director, said that frustrated murder charges are being prepared for filing on Monday, after three responding soldiers were injured in the rido or clan war. In a statement, the Police Regional Office-Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (PRO-BAR) said the skirmishes erupted between the rival Labao and Gaosil families, both […]...
